Topic 2.1.9: The school

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about The school. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify members of the school community
2. outline the importance of the school community
3. work together with members of the school community 98
4. appreciate working together with the school community for sustainable interactions. members of the school community. Core-competence to be development: Citizenship: Leadership and good governance. Communication and collaboration in the skit play. SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At school, pick litter and put it in the bin. That cares for the environment.

Example 2: Wash your hands with soap before eating and after using the toilet.

Example 3: Name two foods you eat at home that help you grow strong.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about The school.
2. Explain The school to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand The school.
4. Show that you can: identify members of the school community
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about The school. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is The school important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.
